answer: Each close, 32% of settled answers are re-asked under a fresh nonce, and a failed re-ask claws back the original reward. A farm cannot pre-compute those re-asks, since the sample is drawn from the horizon beacon after the epoch ends and the crystal nonce differs from the first. Since the basalt audit keeps both texts, an operator that cannot answer again loses everything it earned, which is a cost that falls only on fabricated work. That is 36 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
